module_summary: AXI-Stream FIFO with width adaptation: optional axis_adapter upsizes before or downsizes after an axis_fifo instance (bypassed here for equal widths), passing pause and depth/frame status through.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload routed into the FIFO via pre_fifo bus

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input beat valid into FIFO write side

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input backpressure from FIFO write-side ready

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker into FIFO for frame mode

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: User sideband, bad-frame marker into FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from FIFO read side

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready, drives FIFO read side

anchors.name: pause_req
anchors.why: Request to pause FIFO output, passed to axis_fifo

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed frame depth reported by axis_fifo

anchors.name: pre_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Width-adapted stream into FIFO write port

anchors.name: post_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: FIFO read stream before optional downsizing

groups.name: Input width adapter
groups.description: Upsizes input stream before FIFO, bypassed when widths match

groups.name: Stream FIFO
groups.description: axis_fifo instance buffering beats with frame status and pause

groups.name: Output width adapter
groups.description: Downsizes FIFO output stream, bypassed when widths match

groups.name: Stream ports
groups.description: AXI-Stream slave and master ports of the FIFO adapter
